steps.label: Tempo-Test-Daten einsammeln
steps.run: W=../2208-mt43-speed-prev7; ls -la $W $W/r_test $W/r_prev 2>&1 | head -60 > info.txt; echo ---plog >> info.txt; cat $W/plog.txt >> info.txt 2>&1; echo ---marks >> info.txt; grep -E 'MT43|Fra:' $W/blender_test.log | grep -v -i -E 'bearer|api_key|authorization|token' | awk '{print substr($0,1,160)}' | grep -E 'MT43|Time' | tail -80 >> info.txt; echo ---prevmarks >> info.txt; grep -E 'MT43' $W/blender_prev.log | grep -v -i -E 'bearer|api_key|token' | cut -c1-200 | tail -30 >> info.txt; grep -E '^Fra:' $W/blender_prev.log | awk '{print $1,$2,$3}' | uniq | tail -12 >> info.txt; f=$(ls $W/test.mp4 $W/r_test/* 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] && cp "$f" test.mp4; true
